status: Prospective training protocol; no learned adaptation or qualification yet
hypothesis: Calibrated rim-grasp demonstrations can teach the pretrained action head secure pad placement and release, instead of applying a universal pose offset

placement_teacher.scope: Same task0 training states only; full placement extension, not learned policy
placement_teacher.target: Initial plate center and collision top; measured held bowl-to-EEF offset
placement_teacher.success: Original grasp/hold plus native task goal, physical bowl/plate contact and zero gripper/object contact throughout final0.5sim seconds, center within35mm and motion within5mm

teacher.scope: Training data generator; privileged object geometry/contact truth allowed only here and in independent evaluators
teacher.motion: Original native OSC actions and torque caps; no object edits, welds or pose freezing
teacher.target: Bowl rim and calibrated pad centers, with object/robot collision geometry determining metric targets
teacher.trajectory_revision: Assay001 bilateral pad contact but both220-step budgets exhausted; test a shorter clearance approach and bounded larger commands, not a changed grasp target or judge
teacher.success: Native bilateral pad grasp, at least80mm lift, original joint hold and unchanged10mm/20mrad physical limits for more than1sim second
teacher.failure_policy: Preserve failures. After two similar failures investigate the assumption; do not sweep offsets on the frozen evaluation

learning_plan: Start by adapting the existing L1 action head from original pretrained visual/language features; retain original checkpoint and frozen unadapted baseline
selection: Episode/state-level split, select using validation only; evaluate base and adapted policies on reserved states with complete failure accounting
promotion: Requires original grasp/lift/hold/budget/stale-action/fresh-resume checks plus released/resting placement evidence; no public controller promotion from training loss
